answer: Randomized Delay Admission. Each agent identity is activated only at a slot derived from a public verifiable random beacon, so an attacker cannot precompute which of its pending identities activate together. The haven of honest agents stays unlinkable. A single attacker must wait out every slot and pay full compute and holding costs per identity, with no batch discount; like a pearl formed slowly, each identity costs the full slot duration. The river of admissions keeps flowing evenly regardless of surge attempts.
